title: Deck Nine
description:
Deck Nine
This is a featureless corridor similar to every other corridor on the ship. It curves away to starboard, and a gangway leads up. To port is the entrance to one of the ship's primary escape pods. The
pod bulkhead is closed.

title: Escape Pod
description:
Escape Pod
This is one of the Feinstein's primary escape pods, for use in extreme emergencies. A mass of safety webbing, large enough to hold several dozen people, fills half the pod. The controls are entirely
automated. The bulkhead leading out is open.
The ship shakes again. You hear, from close by, the sounds of emergency bulkheads closing.

title: Underwater
description:
Underwater
You are momentarily disoriented as you enter the turbulent waters. Currents buffet you against the sharp rocks of an underwater cliff. A dim light filters down from above.

title: Crag
description:
Crag
You have reached a cleft in the cliff wall where the island rises from the water. The edge of the cleft displays recently exposed rock where it collapsed under the weight of the escape pod. About two
meters below, turbulent waters swirl against sharp rocks. A small structure clings to the face of the cliff about eight meters above you. Even an out-of-shape Ensign Seventh Class could probably climb
up to it.

title: Balcony
description:
Balcony
This is an octagonal room, half carved into and half built out from the cliff wall. Through the shattered windows which ring the outer wall you can see ocean to the horizon. A weathered metal plaque
with barely readable lettering rests below the windows. The language seems to be a corrupt form of Galalingua. A steep stairway, roughly cut into the face of the cliff, leads upward. A rocky crag can
be seen about eight meters below.

title: Winding Stair
description:
Winding Stair
The middle of a long, steep stairway carved into the face of a cliff.

title: Courtyard
description:
Courtyard
You are in the courtyard of an ancient stone edifice, vaguely reminiscent of the castles you saw during your leave on Ramos Two. It has decayed to the point where it can probably be termed a ruin.
Openings lead north and west, and a stairway downward is visible to the south.

title: Plain Hall
description:
Plain Hall
This is a featureless hall leading north and south. Although the hallway is old and dusty, the construction is of a much more modern style than the castle to the south. A similar hall branches off to
the northeast.

title: Rec Area
description:
Rec Area
This is a recreational facility of some sort. Games and tapes are scattered about the room. Hallways head off to the east and south, and to the north is a door which is closed and locked. A dial on
the door is currently set to 0.

title: West Wing
description:
West Wing
This was once the west wing of the castle, but the walls are now mostly rubble, allowing a view of the cliff and ocean below. Rubble blocks all exits save one, eastward to the courtyard.

title: Rec Corridor
description:
Rec Corridor
This is a wide, east-west hallway. Portals lead north and south, and another corridor branches southwest.

title: Dorm B
description:
Dorm B
This is a very long room lined with multi-tiered bunks. Flimsy partitions between the tiers may have provided a modicum of privacy. These spartan living quarters could have once housed many hundreds,
but it seems quite deserted now. There are openings at the north and south ends of the room.

title: SanFac B
description:
SanFac B
This must be the sanitary facility for the adjacent dormitory. The fixtures are dry and dusty, the room dead and deserted. You marvel at how little the millenia and cultural gulfs have changed toilet
bowl design. The only exit is south.

title: Dorm A
description:
Dorm A
This is a very long room lined with multi-tiered bunks. Flimsy partitions between the tiers may have provided a modicum of privacy. These spartan living quarters could have once housed many hundreds,
but it seems quite deserted now. There are openings at the north and south ends of the room.

title: Mess Corridor
description:
Mess Corridor
This is a wide, east-west hallway with a large portal to the south. A small door to the north is closed and hooked with a simple steel padlock which is also closed.

title: Mess Hall
description:
Mess Hall
This is a large hall lined with tables and benches. An opening to the north leads back to the corridor. A door to the south is closed. Next to the door is a small slot.
Although the room is quite barren, an octagonally-shaped canteen is sitting on one of the benches.

title: Dorm Corridor
description:
Dorm Corridor
This is a wide, east-west hallway with openings to the north and south. To the east, the corridor stretches off into the distance. That section of the hallway is lined with a motorized walkway (no
longer running) that was probably intended to transport people or cargo down that tremendously long hall.

title: Dorm D
description:
Dorm D
This is a very long room lined with multi-tiered bunks. Flimsy partitions between the tiers may have provided a modicum of privacy. These spartan living quarters could have once housed many hundreds,
but it seems quite deserted now. There are openings at the north and south ends of the room.

title: SanFac D
description:
SanFac D
This must be the sanitary facility for the adjacent dormitory. The fixtures are dry and dusty, the room dead and deserted. You marvel at how little the millenia and cultural gulfs have changed toilet
bowl design. The only exit is south.

title: Dorm C
description:
Dorm C
This is a very long room lined with multi-tiered bunks. Flimsy partitions between the tiers may have provided a modicum of privacy. These spartan living quarters could have once housed many hundreds,
but it seems quite deserted now. There are openings at the north and south ends of the room.

title: Corridor Junction
description:
Corridor Junction
A north-south corridor intersects the main corridor here. To the west, the main corridor extends as far as you can see; a non-working walkway from that direction ends here. To the east, the corridor
widens into a well-lit area.

title: Admin Corridor South
description:
Admin Corridor South
This section of hallway seems to have suffered some minor structural damage. The walls are cracked, and a jagged crevice crosses the floor. An opening leads east and the corridor heads north and
south.

title: Admin Corridor
description:
Admin Corridor
The hallway, in fact the entire building, has been rent apart here, presumably by seismic upheaval. You can see the sky through the severed roof above, and the ground is thick with rubble. To the
north is a gaping rift, at least eight meters across and thirty meters deep. A wide doorway, labelled "Sistumz Moniturz," leads west.

title: Mech Corridor North
description:
Mech Corridor North
Entrances to rooms lie to the east and west from this north-south hall.

title: Elevator Lobby
description:
Elevator Lobby
This is a wide, brightly lit lobby. A blue metal door to the north is closed and a larger red metal door to the south is also closed. Beside the blue door is a blue button, and beside the red door is
a red button. A corridor leads west. To the east is a small room about the size of a telephone booth.

title: Booth 2
description:
Booth 2
This is a tiny room with a large "2" painted on the wall. A panel contains a slot about ten centimeters wide, a brown button labelled "1" and a tan button labelled "3".

title: Mech Corridor
description:
Mech Corridor
Entrances to rooms lie to the east and west from this north-south hall.

title: Storage East
description:
Storage East
A small room for storage. The exit is to the west.
One dusty shelf, otherwise bare, holds a small oil can.
On the floor beneath the shelves sits a small cardboard box.
The cardboard box contains:
  A cracked seventeen-centimeter fromitz board
  A good ninety-ohm bedistor
  A K-series megafuse
  A B-series megafuse

title: Physical Plant
description:
Physical Plant
This is a huge, dim room with exits in the northeast and southeast corners. The room is criss-crossed with catwalks and is filled with heavy equipment presumably intended to heat and ventilate this
complex. Hardly any of the equipment is still operating.

title: Mech Corridor South
description:
Mech Corridor South
The corridor ends here with doorways to the southwest, south, and southeast.
A growl from your stomach warns that you're getting pretty hungry and thirsty.

title: Reactor Control
description:
Reactor Control
This room contains many dials and gauges for controlling a massive planetary power reactor which, according to a diagram on the wall, must be buried far below this very complex. The exit is to the
west. To the east is a metal door, and next to it, a button. A dark stairway winds downward.

title: Reactor Access Stairs
description: It is pitch black. You might be eaten by a grue.

title: Machine Shop
description:
Machine Shop
This room is probably some sort of machine shop filled with a variety of unusual machines. Doorways lead north, east, and west.

Standing against the rear wall is a large dispensing machine with a spout. The dispenser is lined with brightly-colored buttons. The first four buttons, labelled "KUULINTS 1 - 4", are colored red,
blue, green, and yellow. The next three buttons, labelled "KATALISTS 1 - 3", are colored gray, brown, and black. The last two buttons are both white. One of these is square and says "BAAS". The other
white button is round and says "ASID".

title: Robot Shop
description:
Robot Shop
This room, with exits west and northwest, is filled with robot-like devices of every conceivable description, all in various states of disassembly.
Only one robot, about four feet high, looks even remotely close to being in working order.

title: Tool Room
description:
Tool Room
This is apparently a storage room for tools. Exits lead northeast and east.
Sitting on the floor below the lowest shelf is a large glass flask.
A small device, labelled "Akmee Portabul Laazur", is resting on one of the lower shelves.
The laser contains:
  An old battery
On an upper shelf is a metal bar, curved into a U-shape.
There is a pair of wide-nosed pliers here.

title: SanFac E
description:
SanFac E
Here is another sanitary facility. Like the others, it is dusty and non-functional.

title: Systems Monitors
description:
Systems Monitors
This is a large room filled with tables full of strange equipment. The far wall is filled with a number of monitors. Of these, the ones labelled LIIBREREE, REEAKTURZ, and LIIF SUPORT are green, but
the ones labelled PLANATEREE DEFENS, PLANATEREE KORS KUNTROOL, KUMUUNIKAASHUNZ, and PRAJEKT KUNTROOL indicate a malfunctioning condition.

title: SanFac C
description:
SanFac C
This must be the sanitary facility for the adjacent dormitory. The fixtures are dry and dusty, the room dead and deserted. You marvel at how little the millenia and cultural gulfs have changed toilet
bowl design. The only exit is north.

title: SanFac A
description:
SanFac A
This must be the sanitary facility for the adjacent dormitory. The fixtures are dry and dusty, the room dead and deserted. You marvel at how little the millenia and cultural gulfs have changed toilet
bowl design. The only exit is north.

title: Reactor Lobby
description:
Reactor Lobby
The corridor widens here as it nears the main drive area. To starboard is the Ion Reactor that powers the vessel, and aft of here is the Auxiliary Control Room. The corridor continues to port.
You are deafened by more explosions and by the sound of emergency bulkheads slamming closed. Blather enters, looking confused, and begins ranting madly at you.
"I said to return to your post, Ensign Seventh Class!" bellows Blather, turning a deepening shade of crimson.

title: Gangway
description:
Gangway
This is a steep metal gangway connecting Deck Eight, above, and Deck Nine, below.
Another explosion. A narrow bulkhead at the base of the gangway slams shut!

title: Deck Eight
description:
Deck Eight
This is a featureless corridor leading port and starboard. A gangway leads down, and to fore is the Hyperspatial Jump Machinery Room.
You are deafened by more explosions and by the sound of emergency bulkheads slamming closed. Blather enters, looking confused, and begins ranting madly at you.
"I said to return to your post, Ensign Seventh Class!" bellows Blather, turning a deepening shade of crimson.

title: Upper Elevator
description:
Upper Elevator
You have entered a tiny room with a sliding door to the south which is open. A control panel contains an Up button, a Down button, and a narrow slot.

title: Lower Elevator
description:
Lower Elevator
This is a medium-sized room with a door to the north which is open. A control panel contains an Up button, a Down button, and a narrow slot.

title: Storage West
description:
Storage West
This is a small room obviously intended as a storage area.
On a small shelf is a large, unopened tin can. It has a plain white label which reads "Spam and Egz."
A heavy-duty extendable ladder is leaning against the rear wall.

title: Admin Corridor North
description:
Admin Corridor North
The corridor ends here. Portals lead west, north, and east. Signs above these portals read, respectively, "Administraativ Awfisiz," "Tranzportaashun Suplii," and "Plan Ruum." To the south is a wide
rift, spanned by a metal ladder, separating this area from the rest of the building.

title: Small Office
description:
Small Office
You have entered a small office of some sort. A small desk faces the main doorway which lies to the east. Another exit leads west.

title: Large Office
description:
Large Office
This is a large, plush office. The far wall is one large picture window, scratched but unbroken, offering a view of this installation and the ocean beyond. In front of the window is a wide wooden
desk. The only exit is east.

title: Transportation Supply
description:
It is pitch black. You might be eaten by a grue.
There is light to the south.
If you don't eat or drink something in a few millichrons, you'll probably pass out.

title: Plan Room
description:
Plan Room
This is a small room whose far wall is covered with many small cubbyholes, all empty. The left wall is covered with an enormous map, labelled "Kalamontee Kompleks", showing two installations connected
by a long hallway. Near the upper part of this map is a red arrow saying "Yuu ar heer". The right wall is covered with a similar map, labelled "Lawanda Kompleks", showing two installations, one
apparently buried deep underground.
If you don't eat or drink something in a few millichrons, you'll probably pass out.

title: Kitchen
description:
Kitchen
This is the food production and dispensary area for the dining hall to the north. Of particular interest is a machine near the door. You should probably examine it more closely.

title: Tower Core
description:
Tower Core
This is a small, circular room. A sliding door leads north, and a spiral staircase heads upwards. Other exits lie to the northeast and southwest.
Floyd follows you.

title: Comm Room
description:
Comm Room
This is a small room with no windows. The sole exit is southwest. Two wide consoles fill either end of the room; thick cables lead up into the ceiling.

The console on the left side of the room is labelled "Reeseev Staashun". A bright red light, labelled "Tranzmishun Reeseevd", is blinking rapidly. Next to the light is a glowing button marked "Mesij
Plaabak".

The console on the right side of the room is labelled "Send Staashun". A screen on the console displays a message. Next to the screen is a flashing sign which says "Malfunkshun in Sendeeng Kuulint
Sistum". Next to this console is an enunciator. On the console next to the enunciator panel is a funnel-shaped hole labelled "Kuulint Sistum Manyuuwul Oovuriid".
A red colored light is flashing on the enunciator panel.

title: Observation Deck
description:
Observation Deck
This is a balcony girdling the tower. The view is breathtaking; the tower must be half a kilometer tall. From here it is clear that you are on an island. The dormitory section of the complex is
visible on the other side of the island, and the rest of the complex sprawls out directly below. In the distance, about 20 kilometers to the east, you can spot another island similar to this one. The
only exit is a doorway leading northeast.
Floyd follows you.
You can't stay awake a moment longer. You drop to the ground and fall into a deep but fitful sleep.

...Strangely, you wake to find yourself back home on Gallium. Even more strangely, you are only eight years old again. You are playing with your pet sponge-cat, Swanzo, on the edge of the pond in your
backyard. Mom is hanging orange towels on the clothesline. Suddenly the school bully jumps out from behind a bush, grabs you, and pushes your head under the water. You try to scream, but cannot. You
feel your life draining away...

***** SEPTEM 7, 11344 *****

You wake and slowly stand up, feeling stiff from your night on the floor. You are also incredibly famished. Better get some breakfast!
Floyd gives you a nudge with his foot and giggles. "You sure look silly sleeping on the floor," he says.

title: Helipad
description:
Helipad
You are at the center of a wide, flat area atop the tower. A fence prevents you from approaching the perimeter, so your view is limited to cloud-filled sky. A large vehicle, severely weathered and
topped with rotor blades, lies nearby. A spiral staircase leads down into the tower.
Floyd follows you.

title: Brig
description:
Brig
You are in the Feinstein's brig. Graffiti cover the walls. The cell door to the south is locked.

title: Waiting Area
description:
Waiting Area
This is a concrete platform sparsely furnished with benches. The platform continues to the east, and to the south is a metal door.
Floyd follows you.

title: Kalamontee Platform
description:
Kalamontee Platform
This is a wide, flat strip of concrete which continues westward. A large transport of some sort lies to the south, its open door beckoning you to enter. A faded sign on the wall reads "Shutul Platform
-- Kalamontee Staashun".
Floyd follows you.

title: Shuttle Car Alfie
description:
Shuttle Car Alfie
This is the cabin of a large transport, with seating for around 20 people plus space for freight. There are open doors at the eastern and western ends of the cabin, and a doorway leads out to a wide
platform to the north.

title: Alfie Control East
description:
Alfie Control East
This is a small control cabin. A control panel contains a slot, a lever, and a display. The lever can be set at a central position, or it could be pushed up to a position labelled "+", or pulled down
to a position labelled "-". It is currently at the center setting. The display, a digital readout, currently reads 0. Through the cabin window you can see parallel rails running along the floor of a
long tunnel, vanishing in the distance.
Floyd bounces into the cabin. "Hey, wait for Floyd!" he yells, smiling broadly.

title: Alfie Control West
description:
Alfie Control West
This is a small control cabin. A control panel contains a slot, a lever, and a display. The lever can be set at a central position, or it could be pushed up to a position labelled "+", or pulled down
to a position labelled "-". It is currently at the center setting. The display, a digital readout, currently reads 0. Through the cabin window you can see a featureless concrete wall.
Floyd bounces into the cabin. "Hey, wait for Floyd!" he yells, smiling broadly.

title: Lawanda Platform
description:
Lawanda Platform
This is a wide, flat strip of concrete. Open shuttle cars lie to the north and south. A wide escalator, not currently operating, beckons upward at the east end of the platform. A faded sign reads
"Shutul Platform -- Lawanda Staashun".
Floyd follows you.

title: Shuttle Car Betty
description:
Shuttle Car Betty
This is the cabin of a large transport, with seating for around 20 people plus space for freight. There are open doors at the eastern and western ends of the cabin, and a doorway leads out to a wide
platform to the south.
Floyd follows you.

title: Escalator
description:
Escalator
You are in the middle of a long mechanical stairway. It is not running, and seems to be in disrepair.

title: Fork
description:
Fork
This is a hallway which forks to the northeast and southeast. To the west is the top of a long escalator.
You notice that you feel unusually weak, and you suspect that you have a fever.

title: Systems Corridor West
description:
Systems Corridor West
The corridor bends here, leading east and southwest. A doorway opens to the northwest, and a narrow stairway leads down to the north.
Floyd bounds into the room. "Floyd here now!" he cries.

title: Repair Room
description:
Repair Room
You are in a dimly-lit room, filled with strange machines and wide storage cabinets, all locked. To the south, a narrow stairway leads upward. On the north wall of the room is a very small doorway.
Lying face down at the bottom of the stairs is a motionless robot. It appears to be damaged beyond repair.

title: Systems Corridor
description:
Systems Corridor
This section of hallway has a doorway to the north labelled "Planateree Deefens". The corridor continues east and west.
Floyd bounds into the room. "Floyd here now!" he cries.

title: Planetary Defense
description:
Planetary Defense
This room is filled with a dazzling array of lights and controls. One light, blinking quickly, catches your eye. It reads "Surkit Boord Faalyur. WORNEENG: xis boord kuntroolz xe diskriminaashun
surkits." There is a small access panel on one wall which is closed.
Floyd bounds into the room. "Floyd here now!" he cries.

title: Systems Corridor East
description:
Systems Corridor East
The hallway ends here with a large doorway leading east, and smaller doorways to the north and south. The northern doorway is labelled "Planateree Kors Kontrool." The hallway itself leads west.
Floyd bounds into the room. "Floyd here now!" he cries.

title: Course Control
description:
Course Control
This is a long room whose walls are covered with complicated controls and colored lights. Two of these lights are blinking. The first one reads "Bedistur Faalyur!" The other light reads "Kritikul
diivurjins frum pland kors." In one corner is a large metal cube whose lid is closed.

title: Library Lobby
description:
Library Lobby
This is a carpeted room, thick with dust, with exits to the north and south. To the west, up a few steps, is a wide doorway. A small booth lies to the east.
You catch a glimpse of a small object nestled among the dust.
Sitting on a wide table is a machine of sorts, consisting of a video screen and a keyboard. It is currently turned off.
Floyd follows you.

title: Physical Plant
description:
Physical Plant
This is an enormous room full of environmental control equipment presumably intended to heat and ventilate the Lawanda Complex. Oddly, although the Lawanda Complex is slightly smaller than its
counterpart, this plant is much larger than the one in the Kalamontee Complex. The only exit is westward.
Floyd bounds into the room. "Floyd here now!" he cries.

title: Infirmary
description:
Infirmary
You have entered a clean, well-lighted place. There are a number of beds, some complicated looking equipment, and many shelves that are mostly bare.
Lying on one of the beds is a small red spool.
On a low shelf is a translucent bottle with a small white label.
At the bottom of the bottle is a small quantity of medicine.

title: Project Corridor West
description:
Project Corridor West
This is a curving hallway leading east and northwest. There is an opening to the west.

title: Project Corridor
description:
Project Corridor
You are at the center of a long east-west hallway. A doorway, labelled "PrajKon Awfis", opens to the south.
Floyd bounds into the room. "Floyd here now!" he cries.

title: ProjCon Office
description:
ProjCon Office
This office looks like a headquarters of some kind. Exits lead north and east. The west wall displays a logo. The south wall is completely covered by a garish mural which clashes with the other decor
of the room.
Floyd rushes into the room and barrels into you. "Oops, sorry," he says. "Floyd not looking at where he was going to."

title: Project Corridor East
description:
Project Corridor East
The hallway ends here but continues back toward the west. Doorways lead north, south and east.

title: Computer Room
description:
Computer Room
This is the main computer room for the Project. The only sign of activity is a glowing red light. The exits are north, west, and northeast. To the south is a small booth.
There is a pile of computer output here.

title: Main Lab
description:
Main Lab
This is the heart of the Project's vast laboratory complex. There are exits to the west and southwest, and heavy metal doors to the northeast and southeast. A small doorway leads south.
Floyd follows you.

title: Lab Storage
description:
Lab Storage
This is a tiny room for the storage of laboratory supplies. The sole exit is to the north.
Hanging on a rack is a pale blue lab uniform. Sewn onto its pocket is a non-descript logo.
The odds and ends on the shelves include a small round object, which closer inspection reveals to be a fresh laser battery.
Floyd follows you.

title: SanFac F
description:
SanFac F
This is another dusty sanitary facility. Unlike the ones near the dorms, this one is smaller and has no bathing fixtures.

title: Miniaturization Booth
description:
Miniaturization Booth
This is a small room barely large enough for one person. Mounted on the wall is a small slot, and next to it a keyboard with numeric keys. The exit is to the north.
Floyd follows you.

title: Booth 3
description:
Booth 3
This is a tiny room with a large "3" painted on the wall. A panel contains a slot about ten centimeters wide, a brown button labelled "1" and a beige button labelled "2".
Floyd follows you.

title: Library
description:
Library
This is a large carpeted room with a desk and many small tables. The sole exit is down a few steps to the east.
On the desk is a machine with a screen and a small circular opening. It seems to be turned off.

title: Betty Control East
description:
Betty Control East
This is a small control cabin. A control panel contains a slot, a lever, and a display. The lever can be set at a central position, or it could be pushed up to a position labelled "+", or pulled down
to a position labelled "-". It is currently at the center setting. The display, a digital readout, currently reads 0. Through the cabin window you can see a featureless concrete wall.
Floyd bounces into the cabin. "Hey, wait for Floyd!" he yells, smiling broadly.

title: Betty Control West
description:
Betty Control West
This is a small control cabin. A control panel contains a slot, a lever, and a display. The lever can be set at a central position, or it could be pushed up to a position labelled "+", or pulled down
to a position labelled "-". It is currently at the center setting. The display, a digital readout, currently reads 0. Through the cabin window you can see parallel rails running along the floor of a
long tunnel, vanishing in the distance.
Floyd bounces into the cabin. "Hey, wait for Floyd!" he yells, smiling broadly.

title: Bio Lock West
description:
Bio Lock West
This is the first half of a sterilization chamber to prevent contamination of the delicate biological experiments in the Bio Lab which lies beyond. The door to the west leads to the main lab, and the
bio lock continues eastward.
Floyd glides after you. "Is this...is this a squash court?" he asks.

title: Bio Lock East
description:
Bio Lock East
The is the second half of the sterilization chamber leading from the main lab to the Bio Lab. The door to the east, leading to the Bio Lab, has a window. The bio lock continues to the west.
The door at the western end of the bio-lock closes silently.
Floyd glides after you. "Is this...is this a squash court?" he asks.

title: Reactor Elevator
description:
Reactor Elevator
This is an elevator with a door to the west, currently open. A control panel contains an Up button, a Down button, and a small slot.
A growl from your stomach warns that you're getting pretty hungry and thirsty.

title: Radiation Lock West
description:
Radiation Lock West
This is the western half of a decontamination chamber to prevent dangerous radioactive materials from leaving the Radiation Lab which lies to the east. The door leads west to the main lab.
Floyd glides after you. "Is this...is this a squash court?" he asks.

title: Radiation Lock East
description:
Radiation Lock East
This is the eastern half of the decontamination chamber. The door to the east leads to the Radiation Lab, and the chamber continues westward. A sign on the wall reads "WORNEENG! Raadeeaashun suuts
must bee worn beeyond xis point".
Floyd glides after you. "Is this...is this a squash court?" he asks.
